title: A 'forbidden' member adds no variant: the engine selects one variant for an interaction whose only operator is 'forbidden'.
why: behavioural spec 'forbidden': contributes no variant dimension — what it admits has one point, and only width earns a dimension (shape spec §6.1). 'optional' and 'forbidden' are near neighbours in the language and it is 'optional' that carries a presence dimension, so the case is the count the engine comes back with: a lone 'forbidden' leaves the space one point wide, and the base variant is the only one there is.

interaction.description: an order that must not carry the customer's tax file number
